company_type: Bangalore-based nanotech startup, IIT Roorkee spinoff (2015)

technology.technology_name: Graphene-enhanced LTO/LFP Fast-Charging Battery + Aluminum-Air Fuel Cell
technology.description: Log9 develops graphene-based lithium-titanate-oxide (LTO) and lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batteries with fast-charging (15–60 min) and tropical thermal stability (-40°C to +65°C). Flagship lines: RapidX (2W/3W EV batteries), Nexmile (commercial EV), Maxval (industrial storage), and aluminium-air fuel cells for long-haul vehicles. India's first commercial Li-ion cell manufacturing facility.
technology.problem_solved: Eliminates import dependency on Chinese cells; offers thermal stability in Indian climate; fast charging suitable for commercial fleets.
technology.innovation_summary: Graphene-felt synthesis (granted patent IN — Sept 2023); aluminum-air fuel cells using graphene membrane to block water-leak / CO2 ingress.
technology.unique_selling_points: 20+ patents in graphene; BIS-certified LTO (2024); India's first Li-ion cell line; PETRONAS + Amara Raja + Sequoia funding
technology.application_area: 2W/3W EV (RapidX), commercial EV (Nexmile), industrial energy storage (Maxval), telecom backup, long-haul transport (Al-air)
technology.target_industries: EV OEMs (2W/3W), commercial fleet operators, telecom tower operators, microgrid developers
technology.potential_customers: Musashi Seimitsu (existing partner since 2024), Indian 2W OEMs, telecom infra companies
technology.trl_level: 7 (Li-ion batteries deployed commercially) — 5 (Al-air fuel cell pilot)
technology.patent_status: 20+ patents filed; multiple granted (incl. graphene-felt synthesis IN granted Sept 2023; filing date Nov 2019)
technology.patent_jurisdiction: IN primary; selected PCT for graphene synthesis
technology.institution_name: IIT Roorkee origin (incubated 2015); partnerships with IISc Bangalore
technology.estimated_market_size: India EV battery market: ~₹50,000 Cr by 2030
technology.preferred_license_type: Patent Buyout for Al-air + graphene; Quick License for BMS / pack designs
technology.routing_tier: Hybrid — Quick License for pack/BMS; Patent Buyout for Al-air fuel cell + graphene synthesis
